QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_42

explanation.text: The Logic: Ch 9.9.1: Sharpe Ratio = (Rp − Rf) / σp. It measures excess return per unit of TOTAL risk, captured by portfolio standard deviation. The Trap: Option A is the Treynor Ratio formula (uses beta, not standard deviation). Options B and D are malformed and do not correspond to any standard risk-adjusted return metric. Note: A higher Sharpe Ratio indicates better risk-adjusted return per unit of total risk.
